definitions.explanation: A small stick with a tip that ignites when struck.

examples.english: To light a fire with a match.

notes:
マッチ is from English "match" - the small stick used to light fire. Less common now due to lighters.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- マッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{擦|す}る→擦る：04262_kosuru⟧: to strike a match
- マッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to light with a match
- マッチ⟦{箱|ばこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧: matchbox
- マッチ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧: matchstick

WATCH OUT:
マッチ can also mean:
- match (sports competition), mainly in compounds: タイトルマッチ (title match); an ordinary soccer match is ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧
- match (going well together), as the verb マッチ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧マッチ⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (the clothes and shoes go well together)
Context determines the meaning.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ライター→ライター：00350_raitaa⟧: lighter (more common now)
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧: fire
- ⟦{着火|ちゃっか}する→着火する：27999_chakkasuru⟧: to ignite

CULTURAL NOTE:
マッチ⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧ (The Little Match Girl) is the famous fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen.
